Aisha (PM): Quick ask: we need a one-pager + checklist for audit evidence exports. Must cover: immutable logs, BYOK metadata (no key material), legal-hold blocking, and SLA behavior when export workers are saturated. Who owns each?
Ravi (Security): Security owns integrity & verify tooling: batch HMACs, manifest schema, verify.sh. No raw keys in export, only key IDs and KMS access lines.
Liam (Eng-Platform): I'll own the export worker design and queueing + ETA surface. Suggest policy: start_immediately if workers>=2, else queue_with_eta, block_if_legal_hold.
Marta (SRE): I'll own runbook + drills. Two drills: (1) worker saturation -> delayed exports + console ETA; (2) legal hold -> blocked export + approval flow.
Noah (CS): Customer acceptance test: trigger export -> receive ZIP -> run verify.sh -> confirm manifests, per-file HMACs, signed manifest, and retention headers.
Jo (Legal): Approvals: export blocked when legal_hold=true. To override: 2x Legal + 1x Compliance sign-off; log approver IDs & timestamps.
Aisha (PM): Ownership: Eng-Platform (worker + manifest), Security (HMAC/verify), SRE (runbook), CS (acceptance tests), Legal (approval policy). I'll draft PRD page and send by EOD Friday.
